handoff_sentence: v463A_GMUT_v6 records scalar-only readiness under explicit first-pass assumptions: convention selected for review, V(Psi) symbolic, EOM route prepared, T_Psi_mu_nu held, null fixture designed, conservation-not-exchange targeted only for the minimal decoupled scalar route, and all GMUT gates open.
v7_allowed_outputs: bounded scalar EOM derivation attempt under the v6 convention
metric-variation stress-energy derivation attempt or explicit hold
null fixture dry-run execution or explicit hold
conservation divergence check or explicit hold
v7_forbidden_outputs: claiming EOM completion without derivation artifact
claiming T_Psi_mu_nu accepted without metric variation
claiming null recovery or baseline recovery from dry-run design alone
claiming conservation derived from conservation target selection
claiming fifth-force/equivalence clearance without model-to-bound mapping
claiming GMUT validation or final physics
no_gate_closure_statement: v7 begins from readiness, hold, design, and open statuses; it must not inherit any v6 row as validated or closed.
